abstract: BACKGROUND: Testicular embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (ERMS) is a rare type of testicular neoplasm. This study aimed to conduct a differential diagnosis between testicular seminoma and testicular ERMS based on enhanced CT features. METHODS: In this retrospective study, 15 cases of intratesticular ERMS that were pathologically confirmed and 30 cases of testicular seminoma were collected from December 2012 to May 2024. The general information of the patients was collected, and CT images were retrieved, reviewed, and reanalyzed. CT parameters were measured (the length and short diameter of each lesion, as well as the CT attenuation in the non-enhanced phase, arterial phase, and venous phase), as well as laboratory indicators such as alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), and β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-HCG). Statistical analysis for quantitative data was conducted using an independent sample t-test or a non-parametric test, while the chi-square test was used for qualitative parameters. Further, a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was conducted to test the diagnostic value for differential diagnosis. The existence of postoperative disease progression (recurrence or metastasis) in the two groups was compared using the chi-square test. RESULTS: A total of 45 patients were involved in the study (15 intratesticular ERMS and 30 testicular seminoma). There were differences in age, CT parameters, and laboratory indicators between rhabdomyosarcoma and seminoma (all p < 0.05). Similarly, the parallel relationship between the lesion and the ipsilateral inguinal region, as well as the vascular ball sign and other signs, also showed statistically significant differences (all p < 0.05). Further single and multi-factor analyses revealed that the parallel relationship between the lesion and the ipsilateral inguinal region, as well as the vascular ball sign, showed statistically significant differences (p < 0.05). The area under the ROC curve (AUC) of the model by logistic regression reached 0.961 [95% confidence interval (CI), 0.857-0.996], with a sensitivity of 86.7% and a specificity of 96.7%. Furthermore, the probability of postoperative disease progression of testicular ERMS is significantly higher than that of testicular seminoma (66.67% vs. 3.3%). Among the 15 ERMS patients, 10 cases (66.7%) had postoperative disease progression, including five cases of recurrence and five cases of distant metastasis. The median time to progression was 7 months (range 2-16.5 months). CONCLUSIONS: The existence of a parallel relationship between the lesion and the ipsilateral inguinal region, as well as the vascular ball sign, is helpful in differentiating testicular ERMS from testicular seminoma.
abstract_ja: 背景：精巣の胎児性横紋筋肉腫(ERMS)は稀な精巣腫瘍である。本研究の目的は、造影CT所見に基づき精巣セミノーマと精巣ERMSを鑑別することであった。方法：本後方視的研究では、2012年12月から2024年5月までに収集された、病理学的に確定した精巣内ERMS 15例と精巣セミノーマ30例を対象とした。患者の一般情報を収集し、CT画像を検索・確認・再解析した。CTパラメータ(各病変の長径と短径、非造影相、動脈相、静脈相のCT値)と、アルファフェトプロテイン(AFP)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)、β-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(β-HCG)などの検査指標を測定した。定量データは独立サンプルt検定または非パラメトリック検定を、定性的パラメータはカイ二乗検定を用いて統計解析した。さらに、鑑別診断の診断価値を検討するため、受信者動作特性(ROC)曲線解析を行った。両群における術後の疾患進行(再発または転移)の有無をカイ二乗検定で比較した。結果：本研究には合計45例(精巣内ERMS 15例、精巣セミノーマ30例)が含まれた。横紋筋肉腫とセミノーマの間で、年齢、CTパラメータ、検査指標に差を認めた(すべてp<0.05)。同様に、病変と同側鼠径部との平行関係や血管球徴などの所見も統計的に有意な差を示した(すべてp<0.05)。さらに単変量および多変量解析により、病変と同側鼠径部との平行関係と血管球徴のみが有意差を示した(p<0.05)。ロジスティック回帰モデルのAUCは0.961(95%信頼区間0.857～0.996)で、感度86.7%、特異度96.7%であった。さらに、精巣ERMSの術後疾患進行の確率は精巣セミノーマよりも有意に高かった(66.67%対3.3%)。ERMS 15例のうち10例(66.7%)に術後疾患進行を認め、内訳は再発5例、遠隔転移5例であった。進行までの期間の中央値は7か月(範囲2～16.5か月)であった。結論：病変と同側鼠径部との平行関係と血管球徴の存在は、精巣ERMSと精巣セミノーマの鑑別に有用である。
